messages:
deploy-bot: Rollout started: canary=10% prompt-router -> experimental endpoint promptv6 (commit abc123). watching telemetry.

incident-bot: @maya page triggered: high-error-rate on new endpoint (severity: P1) — paged oncall.

maya (oncall): Ack — looking. Where is traffic routed?

jordan (sre): Seeing spike in 502/504 from promptv6 instances, 95p latency ~2.3s -> 5s. Error pattern: upstream model connect timeouts.

maya (oncall): Thanks. Can we kill the flag for promptv6 canary? would like to stop traffic to experimental endpoint.

lee (product): Confirming this is the new promptV6 routing for experimental prompt improvements — customers may see degraded replies. Prioritize safety.

maya (oncall): Executing emergency FF kill now. Command: ```
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_API_KEY' \ 
  https://flags.redwood/api/toggles/promptv6/disable \ 
  -d '{"scope":"prod-canary-10"}'
```

jordan (sre): Observability: backend tail shows connection reset by peer to model-host-3, TLS handshake fails intermittently. Might be kernel-level NVLink flaps on those nodes.

sam (oncall-night): Picking up — checking GPU pool telemetry and deployments in that AZ.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic diverted to stable route promptv5. All new requests should land on stable.

maya (oncall): Confirming: error rate on overall prompt routing dropping. 5xx rate from 10% -> 0.4% in last 30s. Latency trending back to baseline.

cs-ops: Heads-up: a few enterprise customers reported delayed responses during window ~2m. We're drafting comms.

jordan (sre): Plan: keep FF off for promptv6, revert canary rollout, snapshot kernel logs for impacted nodes, and open infra ticket for NVLink investigation.

maya (oncall): Handoff to @sam for overnight monitoring. Sam, you have console access + rollback artifacts in #eng-runtime.

sam (oncall-night): Got it, I have access. I'll run extended tail for 2 hours and escalate if any reappearance.

lee (product): Postmortem owners: eng-runtime + infra. We'll coordinate CS comms + customer list.

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated). Summary: experimental promptv6 canary caused upstream timeouts; FF kill diverted traffic to stable; oncall handoff to sam.

maya (oncall): Adding short notes to the incident tracker, linking logs and FF toggle audit.

cs-ops: Notifying affected customers with mitigation note and apology.

jordan (sre): Thanks team. Follow-up actions: 1) repro on staging with same kernel + model variant, 2) validate NVLink health across pool, 3) add guardrail to auto-fail canary if 5xx > 1% within 5m.

sam (oncall-night): Acknowledged. Monitoring set, will ping if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
